text: {"features":[{"evidence":"Daer Hiring Team","name":"Proofreading accuracy","description":"Measures how free the letter is from distracting spelling, grammar, and addressing errors.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent typos, misspellings, or wrong headings materially hurt readability or credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors are present but the letter remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Only occasional minor errors appear and they do not meaningfully distract."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Cleanly proofread with no obvious mechanical mistakes."}]},{"evidence":"The moment that shaped my engineering priorities","name":"Narrative throughline","description":"Captures whether the letter has a coherent story or governing idea rather than a disconnected list of claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly a flat inventory of qualifications with little connective logic."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Some rationale is present, but the letter still reads choppily or modularly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A clear theme ties the opening, evidence, and motivation together."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"A memorable opening idea or story is sustained throughout and shapes the whole letter."}]},{"evidence":"ground-up redesign of a high-throughput lookup service","name":"Claim specificity","description":"Measures how concretely the applicant describes past work, technologies, and situations.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Claims stay vague, with few concrete systems, tasks, or examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specifics, but many claims remain generic or unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives multiple concrete examples with recognizable technical detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly uses precise, technically informative mini-examples that make the work easy to picture."}]},{"evidence":"Go back-end systems and Python AI agents","name":"Role tailoring","description":"Captures how directly the letter maps the applicant's background to this particular Google security engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could fit almost any software role, with little sign of tailoring to this posting."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows broad interest in security or Google, but only loosely connects to the stated responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly aligns several experiences with the posting's technologies or duties."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Tightly maps past work to the role's specific problems, tools, and team mission."}]},{"evidence":"too many signals, too few experts","name":"Security automation strategy","description":"Measures whether the applicant shows a systems-level understanding of scaling security work through automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No real framing of the security-scaling problem beyond wanting to automate things."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses generic interest in automation or reducing manual work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly describes leverage such as reducing toil, scaling expert attention, or centralizing defenses."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced strategic thinking about bottlenecks, capacity multiplication, variant analysis, or organization-wide security automation."}]},{"evidence":"make the secure path the easy path","name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"Captures how strongly the letter frames security work as helping developers act securely with less friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Little or no mention of serving developer teams or improving their workflow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in secure development, but not much user-facing empathy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes reducing friction, toil, or manual burden for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames security as a service to busy developers, stressing defaults, usability, and partnership rather than policing."}]},{"evidence":"Go is my principal programming language","name":"Go centrality","description":"Measures how central Go appears in the applicant's recent backend work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is barely mentioned or only listed among many tools."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go appears in recent work, but not as a clear core language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Go is stated as the primary or daily language."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Go is primary and tied to clear ownership of backend services or infrastructure."}]},{"evidence":"Python became my workhorse","name":"Python depth","description":"Captures the depth of Python use for production services, automation, and analysis.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful Python experience is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned, but only lightly or without strong evidence of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python use for services, tooling, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows deep, production-grade Python use with strong evidence of maintainable services or major automation layers."}]},{"evidence":"built and shipped LLM-based features","name":"AI production exposure","description":"Measures whether the applicant has actually deployed AI or model-backed functionality rather than only expressing interest.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"AI experience is mentioned vaguely or as experimentation rather than delivery."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states production experience shipping model-backed or LLM-based functionality."}]},{"evidence":"evaluation scaffolding required to deploy them responsibly","name":"AI operational discipline","description":"Captures whether the applicant shows maturity about evaluating, hardening, or constraining AI systems in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No discussion of reliability, evaluation, or safeguards around AI systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly acknowledges trust, predictability, or reliability concerns."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly discusses evaluation, guardrails, hardening, or other dependable-deployment practices."}]},{"evidence":"designed agentic pipelines end to end","name":"Agentic architecture ownership","description":"Measures how much direct design responsibility the applicant claims for agent-based systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agent-based experience is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or agentic systems, but only at a high level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes end-to-end design of agentic tooling using the role's technology pattern."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Claims strong architecture ownership with concrete explanation of how agents and services are structured."}]},{"evidence":"bounded, auditable actions","name":"Agent control model","description":"Captures whether the letter addresses permissions, boundaries, logging, or auditability for autonomous agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agent-control or safety model is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Constraints are implied, but not spelled out concretely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly describes guardrails such as permissions, boundaries, logging, or auditing of agent actions."}]},{"evidence":"threat modeling and code review","name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Measures the depth and formality of the applicant's security review experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security assessment work is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions reviews or assessments in generic terms only."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives concrete assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, findings, or remediation follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents assessments as structured engineering practice or design analysis carried out across systems."}]},{"evidence":"automates triage of incoming vulnerability reports","name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"Captures whether the applicant has built automation for intake, classification, deduplication, routing, or prioritization of security reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No vulnerability-workflow automation is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation generally, but not specifically for vulnerability handling."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes concrete vulnerability triage automation such as classification, deduplication, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows concrete triage automation plus a clear operational change such as major manual-work reduction or a queue becoming routine."}]},{"evidence":"replaced ad-hoc traversals with proper graph algorithms","name":"Data structures fluency","description":"Measures how convincingly the letter demonstrates practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful evidence of data-structure or algorithm skill appears."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Asserts strong algorithmic ability, but with little concrete support."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one specific redesign or optimization example."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong recent example tied to clear gains in performance, tractability, or system simplicity."}]},{"evidence":"3 years ... 5 years ... 7 years","name":"Professional seniority","description":"Captures the level of post-degree software experience the applicant reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Roughly 3 years of experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Roughly 5 years of experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Roughly 7 or more years of experience."}]},{"evidence":"launched 2 ... 4 ... 6 production services","name":"Delivery volume","description":"Measures how much shipped-service experience the applicant claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"About 2 production services launched."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"About 4 production services launched."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"6 or more production services launched."}]},{"evidence":"measured its worth in the hours of expert attention it returned","name":"Impact articulation","description":"Captures how clearly the letter explains the outcome or leverage of past work rather than only the activity.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes tasks or responsibilities without clear outcomes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies usefulness, but leaves the result mostly unstated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a concrete outcome such as saved time, reduced manual work, or improved behavior."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes the impact vivid through quantification or a strongly legible before-and-after result."}]},{"evidence":"maintain an open-source Go library","name":"Open-source engagement","description":"Measures the extent of the applicant's upstream contribution or maintenance experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source activity is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or bug fixes upstream."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution or maintainer responsibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows stewardship of a project with external users or contributors, including release or review ownership."}]},{"evidence":"CompTIA Security+ ... OSCP certification","name":"Security credential level","description":"Captures the strength of formal security credentials mentioned in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security credential is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a baseline credential such as CompTIA Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions an advanced hands-on credential such as OSCP."}]},{"evidence":"capture-the-flag competitions","name":"Offensive practice","description":"Measures whether the applicant maintains offensive security practice outside ordinary engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No offensive-security practice is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional participation in CTFs or similar exercises."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular ongoing participation in CTFs or offensive practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows regular practice plus strong competitive results or near-top finishes."}]},{"evidence":"distributed task queue with exactly-once semantics","name":"Personal project ambition","description":"Captures the technical ambition of self-directed side projects mentioned as evidence of initiative.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No personal project is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small utility or simple app."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a substantial side project with clear systems or infrastructure depth."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Mentions an ambitious distributed or failure-heavy project built to confront hard engineering problems."}]},{"evidence":"Bachelor's degree ... Master's degree ... Doctoral degree","name":"Degree level","description":"Measures the highest degree level the applicant claims, which matters because the posting prefers graduate study.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree."}]}]}
